one_line: Photo to print-ready sketch in ten styles at up to 4K, live in production, with a free tier that is defensible because sign-in, caps and rate limits were engineered first.

sections.accomplishments: Shipped live with users in 18 countries, and used their own analytics to find that broad ad targeting was sending low-intent traffic plus real conversion bugs in the funnel. Cost per sketch is low enough that the free tier is sustainable.
sections.challenges: A free-render tool attracts abuse, so sign-in is mandatory and generation is hard-capped; Google blocks sign-in inside Facebook and Instagram in-app browsers, so they built an escape that routes those users to a real browser; the model in the original plan was retired mid-build and the pipeline was migrated with no downtime.
sections.how_we_built_it: Gemini as the engine rather than an add-on: the image model renders the sketch from photo plus style, and a cheaper fast model reads the photo first so the result stays true to the subject. Next.js 15 on Vercel, Supabase for Google sign-in, Cloudflare R2 for storage, Upstash for rate limiting, Stripe for live payments, PostHog for analytics.
sections.inspiration: Print-on-demand sellers need custom sketch art; commissioning an artist is slow and expensive while cheap photo filters are not sellable, so the gap is a result good enough to put on a product at a solo seller's price.
sections.learned: Traffic quality beats volume - cheap clicks convert at nearly zero - and the funnel matters as much as the traffic: one broken login button silently sank motivated visitors until analytics caught it.
sections.what_it_does: Upload a photo, pick one of ten styles (pencil, charcoal, ink, watercolor, line art and others), get a high-resolution sketch exportable for print up to 4K. Three free renders after one-tap Google sign-in, then credits. Running in production.
sections.what_next: A product demo as the primary ad creative, bulk generation and an API for print shops, more styles and larger exports.

testing: No unit or eval suite is described; the measurable loop they do have is product analytics - PostHog funnel inspection that found conversion bugs and mispriced ad targeting. That is a real feedback mechanism, just not a quality gate on output fidelity.
